# Part 0: Unity .gitignore (2 mins)

[< Back to Workshop](./README.md) | [< Previous: Merge Conflicts](./05-merge-conflicts.md)

---

For those working with Unity, add this `.gitignore` to your project root **before your first commit**:

```gitignore
# Unity generated
/[Ll]ibrary/
/[Tt]emp/
/[Oo]bj/
/[Bb]uild/
/[Bb]uilds/
/[Ll]ogs/
/[Uu]ser[Ss]ettings/

# MemoryCaptures
/[Mm]emoryCaptures/

# Recordings
/[Rr]ecordings/

# Asset meta data should only be ignored when the corresponding asset is also ignored
!/[Aa]ssets/**/*.meta

# Autogenerated Crash Reports
sysinfo.txt

# Builds
*.apk
*.aab
*.unitypackage
*.app

# OS generated
.DS_Store
Thumbs.db
```

**Key point:** Never commit the `Library/` folder. It's auto-generated and massive.

You can also grab a comprehensive one from [github.com/github/gitignore](https://github.com/github/gitignore/blob/main/Unity.gitignore).
